title: The generalized Mukai conjecture
summary: We prove the generalized Mukai conjecture: every positive-dimensional smooth complex Fano manifold of dimension n , Picard number ρ , and pseudoindex ι satisfies $`\rho(\iota-1)\le n`$. Equality holds precisely for the product of ρ copies of $`\mathbb P^{\iota-1}`$.

review.reason: Proves a bound relating Picard number, pseudoindex and dimension for smooth complex Fano manifolds.
